name: Carlos D. Cordero
office: City of Palmdale, Member of the City Council, 3rd District

items.text: Carlos D. Cordero is a candidate for Palmdale City Council District 3. He is a sales associate.

sentences.text: Carlos D. Cordero is a candidate for Palmdale City Council District 3.

items.text: He says he is running to encourage greater civic engagement and help ensure every resident feels their voice matters. He also says residents deserve to feel safe and calls for strengthening trust between the community and local government.
